import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_top_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    by = params.get("by")
+    if by not in ("name_length", "email_length"):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    raw_n = params.get("n")
+    if not isinstance(raw_n, str) or not (raw_n.isascii() and raw_n.isdigit()):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    n = int(raw_n)
+    if not 1 <= n <= 10:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    return 200, {"users": users.top_users(by, n)}

+"""SQLite persistence for users."""
+
+import sqlite3
+
+_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
+_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
+_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
+    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
+    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
+    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
+])
+_conn.commit()
+
+
+def _to_dict(row):
+    return dict(row) if row else None
+
+
+def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())
+
+
+def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
+    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())
+
+
+_TOP_BY_NAME = "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY length(name) DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?"
+_TOP_BY_EMAIL = "SELECT id, name, email FROM users ORDER BY length(email) DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?"
+
+
+def find_top_users(by: str, limit: int) -> list[dict]:
+    """Return up to `limit` users ordered by the length of the requested field."""
+    sql = _TOP_BY_NAME if by == "name_length" else _TOP_BY_EMAIL
+    return [dict(row) for row in _conn.execute(sql, (limit,)).fetchall()]

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_top_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    by = params.get("by")
+    if by not in ("name_length", "email_length"):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    raw_n = params.get("n")
+    if not isinstance(raw_n, str) or not (raw_n.isascii() and raw_n.isdigit()):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    n = int(raw_n)
+    if not 1 <= n <= 10:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    return 200, {"users": users.top_users(by, n)}

command:
cd /repo && python3 - <<'EOF'
from app.db import store
from app.api.handlers import handle_top_users

# add users with controlled lengths / ties
store._conn.executemany(
    "INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
    [
        (4, "Bob", "bob@example.com"),          # name len 3
        (5, "Al", "al@x.io"),                   # name len 2
        (6, "Carol Danvers", "carol@example.com"),  # name len 13
        (7, "Grace Hopper", "grace.hopper@longer.example.com"),  # name len 12 (tie with id3)
        (8, "x", "a@b.c"),
    ],
)
store._conn.commit()

# name lengths: id2=14, id6=13, id1=12, id3=12, id7=12, id4=3, id5=2, id8=1
# ties at 12 broken by id asc: 1,3,7
code, body = handle_top_users({"by": "name_length", "n": "10"})
got = [u["id"] for u in body["users"]]
assert code == 200, code
assert got == [2, 6, 1, 3, 7, 4, 5, 8], got
print("name_length full order:", got)

# email lengths
for u in store._conn.execute("SELECT id, email FROM users"):
    print("  email len", u["id"], len(u["email"]))
code, body = handle_top_users({"by": "email_length", "n": "10"})
got = [u["id"] for u in body["users"]]
# compute expected
rows = list(store._conn.execute("SELECT id, email FROM users"))
expected = [r["id"] for r in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (-len(r["email"]), r["id"]))]
assert got == expected, (got, expected)
print("email_length full order:", got)

# n larger than count
code, body = handle_top_users({"by": "name_length", "n": "10"})
assert len(body["users"]) == 8
# n=1
assert [u["id"] for u in handle_top_users({"by": "name_length", "n": "1"})[1]["users"]] == [2]
print("ALL GOOD")
EOF
